name: Cold-stage microscopy of ice-crystal recrystallization in ice cream
plain_name: Watch ice crystals grow in ice cream
description: An optical food-structure experiment. Animation illustrates crystal shape changes and never invents measured growth rates.
keywords: Watch ice crystals grow in ice cream
